refusal (none)
note The sweep's 0 Hz point is answered by circuitRF's conduction solve of the conductors, not by the 3D solver.
note 4 overlapping conductor shape(s) were merged into 2 — copper that overlaps on one level is one conductor, in 3D as in the planar model.
note Resistive film 'Resistor' on 'Metal1' is a sheet at σ = 4E+05 S/m × t = 50 nm (a thickness well under a skin depth, picked because the layer states none), 50 Ω/sq: for a sheet only the product is physical. It stays a sheet beside solid metal, because a film's own thickness is a mesh nobody should be asked to pay for.
note Dielectric 'MIM Dielectric' exists only where 'Nitride' is drawn, and nothing is drawn there, so it is not in the 3D problem.
note Port 1 ('1') at (0, 0 µm) was taken to be on the conductor's low-x (left) end (inferred from the nearest conductor boundary), driving current in the +x direction, at 50 Ω.
note Port 2 ('2') at (800, 0 µm) was taken to be on the conductor's high-x (right) end (inferred from the nearest conductor boundary), driving current in the −x direction, at 50 Ω.
note Port 1 at its line's end is a vertical lumped sheet 73 µm wide and 100 µm tall from 'Metal1' down to 'Backside Metal' (the air box's floor): the nearest ground-reference plane with metal under the port.
note Port 2 at its line's end is a vertical lumped sheet 73 µm wide and 100 µm tall from 'Metal1' down to 'Backside Metal' (the air box's floor): the nearest ground-reference plane with metal under the port.
note The air box's floor is 'Backside Metal' as a PEC plane at 3 µm: it is the lowest ground-reference conductor, nothing is drawn on it and nothing is drawn below it.
note 'Metal1/1' and 1 other conductor(s) are under 3 skin depths thick at 1 GHz, so Thin Metal Correction gives the faces that thickness (2.85 µm on 'Metal1/1'). Its resistance levels off at the DC value. Near two to three skin depths a line can still read up to 25 % low. A wide line close to ground can read high, because its faces carry unequal current: up to 20 % on a line 5 times wider than its height over ground, and 50 % at 50 times.
